title: Jumio Android SDK v4.14.0
impact_summary: The SDK includes accessibility updates to meet WCAG 2.2 AA and EAA compliance requirements.
backbase_rationale: Backbase must ensure their applications adhere to WCAG 2.2 AA and EAA standards for compliance.

title: Jumio Android SDK v4.18.0
impact_summary: The SDK now requires a minimum Android SDK version of 24, affecting all applications targeting lower versions.
backbase_rationale: Backbase must update their Android app target SDK to 24 or higher to remain compatible with the SDK.

title: SMS Delivery Delays from a Subset of Twilio Short Codes and Long Codes to Appalachian Wireless United States
impact_summary: Twilio customers may be experiencing SMS delivery delays from a subset of Twilio Short Codes and Long Codes to Appalachian Wireless network subscribers in the United States. Our team has identified the cause, and is working to resolve the issue. We will provide another update in 2 hours or as soon as more information becomes available.
backbase_rationale: Backbase needs to monitor the incident to ensure customer messaging remains reliable.

title: SMS Delivery Failures from a Subset of Twilio Long Codes to Iliad Italy
impact_summary: We have observed a recovery in SMS delivery from a subset of Twilio Long Codes to Iliad network subscribers in Italy and are monitoring service stability. We will provide another update in 2 hours or as soon as more information becomes available.
backbase_rationale: Backbase needs to monitor the incident to ensure customer messaging remains reliable.

title: Update to SendGrid Domain Authentication: Send to Coworker Action Removed
impact_summary: Send to Coworker action removed from Domain Authentication setup flow.

title: Verify tightens fraud prevention geo permissions for Italy and Argentina
impact_summary: Default geo permission for Italy and Argentina will change from Allow all traffic to Monitor all traffic for fraud.
backbase_rationale: Ensure compliance with new fraud prevention posture.
